title: PCR Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Mastermix is distributed to final plate (multi-channel pipette).
Sample is added to final plate.

steps.title: Prepare mastermix in tube
steps.instruction: Make the mastermix in an empty tube placed in a tube rack, using reagent volumes calculated for the total number of samples.

steps.title: Dispense mastermix to plate
steps.instruction: Using a single‑channel pipette, transfer the mastermix to the first column of the middle PCR plate located in slot 2.
